mapper.select: select cast(b.id as char) id, cast(b.department_id as char) departmentId, d.code departmentCode, d.name department, b.fiscal_year fiscalYear, b.amount allocated from fin_budget b join sys_department d on d.id=b.department_id where b.fiscal_year=#{fiscalYear} order by d.sort_order, d.id
select count(*) from sys_department where id=#{departmentId} and deleted=0
mapper.insert: insert into fin_budget(department_id, fiscal_year, amount, created_by, updated_by) values (#{departmentId}, #{fiscalYear}, #{amount}, #{userId}, #{userId}) on duplicate key update amount=values(amount), updated_by=values(updated_by)
mapper.select: select amount from fin_budget where department_id=#{departmentId} and fiscal_year=#{fiscalYear} limit 1
